title: Smooth cut-offs of a compact Lebesgue-null set (parent steps 4 and 5(ii))
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and let K ⊆ ℝⁿ (Euclid n) be compact with Lebesgue measure λ(K) = 0. Then there are functions a_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) such that: each a_k is C^∞ with compact support and 0 ≤ a_k ≤ 1; a_k = 1 on K for every k; for every y ∉ K, a_k(y) = 0 for all sufficiently large k; and ∫ a_k dλ → 0 as k → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid n)), IsCompact K → volume K = 0 → ∃ a : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ, (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (a k)) ∧ (∀ k, HasCompactSupport (a k)) ∧ (∀ k y, 0 ≤ a k y) ∧ (∀ k y, a k y ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ k, ∀ y ∈ K, a k y = 1) ∧ (∀ y, y ∉ K → ∀ᶠ k in atTop, a k y = 0) ∧ Tendsto (fun k => ∫ y, a k y) atTop (𝓝 0)
